water_activity.note: From freezing point -0.8 C (AH-66) via ln aw = -0.00969*dTf (Chirife & Fontan 1982) = 0.992

respiration.note: AH-66 gives rates only at 12.5 C: American 60-78, White 104-122, Japanese 124-138 mg CO2/kg.h. Indian brinjal spans round and long types so the full range is used (v = midpoint). No second temperature in source, so Ea is omitted and the engine's flagged Q10 fallback applies

storage_optimum.note: AH-66: 10-12 C, 90-95% RH; quality deteriorates rapidly after 14 days. Cantwell 2001: 1-2 weeks. Chilling injury after 6-8 d at 5 C (American 6-7 d, Japanese 8-9 d)

ethylene.note: 0.1-0.7 uL/kg.h at 12.5 C; moderate-to-high sensitivity - >1 uL/L causes calyx abscission and browning (AH-66). Keep away from ginger/onion odours

cut.note: AH-66 lists no fresh-cut potential for eggplant; respiration_x from KB generic mod_cut (USDA-AH66); 4 h = FDA Food Code 3-501.19 time-as-control limit
